title: Introduced to Jake Barber before he went public
summary: Jordan tells of Introduced to Jake Barber before he went public, about June 2024 at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I met him I think it was like June of 24 or something along those lines.

plain: A guest named Jordan, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says he was introduced to a man named Jake Barber around June 2024, before Barber went public with his own story. Jordan links the meeting to another man, Ross Cohart. If true, it would mean people in this circle knew Barber before the public did.
